name: BP
notes: operatingIncome = BP's reported 'Profit (loss) before interest and taxation' (PBIT): income before finance costs, pension finance items and tax, including BP's share of equity-accounted earnings (joint ventures, associates, Rosneft 2013-2021), disposal gains and impairments. 2000-2003 UK GAAP 'historical cost profit before interest and tax' (includes inventory holding gains and losses); 2004+ IFRS. Revenue: 2000-2003 UK GAAP 'Group turnover' (excl. joint ventures); 2004+ IFRS 'Total revenues and other income' (2004-2006 continuing operations, ex-Innovene). Visible discontinuity 2003->2004 from UK GAAP->IFRS and restatement. Figures as first reported in the Q4/full-year results 6-Ks (2000-2014; 2012-2013 as restated in the FY2013 6-K, 2004-2007 from continuing operations) and in the 20-F for 2015+. FY ends Dec 31.
